summary: The change updates every stale 15-minute lifetime claim in README.md to the 15-minute default and 30-day maximum, updates the signing-key overlap to 30 days, and adds a regression test tying the documented values to the auth configuration.

evidence: README.md lines 126-129 now document a 15-minute default and 30-day maximum for SSO access tokens and the stale-authorization/introspection consequence.
README.md line 138 documents a 30-day signing-key overlap matching accessTokenMaxTtlMs.
README.md lines 188-189 and 210-212 update the agent-exchange and app-migration lifetime statements to the 15-minute default and 30-day maximum.
tests/passport_cutover_test.ts adds a regression test asserting the README lifetime and overlap wording against AuthConfig values.
